figures.question: Do mode energy and charge remain controlled for the full refined baseline?
figures.reading: Final fine-grid mode change -6.23e-06; fine energy residual 0.806 initial mode energies.
figures.significance: Refined and time-step controls close the missing 100-period usability check. The energy diagnostic improves with time refinement.
figures.limitation: Near-constant projection does not measure a tiny radiation spectrum. A 100-period wide-box run and angular stability remain untested.
transformations: subtract initial normalized quantities; historical energy residual divided by initial mode energy

figures.question: Does the same local radius keep ticking over 100 periods on each grid?
figures.reading: All grids have 100 positive-going ticks. Fine frequency 0.412748290; largest relative grid/time difference 4.92e-06.
figures.significance: The full refined duration now supports using this radial core as a finite-duration local clock.
figures.limitation: The ideal probe samples r=0.1 in the fixed flat rest frame; no remote marker or nonspherical stability is established.
transformations: time divided by frozen nominal eigenperiod; first/last four periods; raw local field
